actual_physical_data.paper: Storz et al., Loophole-free Bell inequality violation with superconducting circuits, Nature 617 265 (2023)
actual_physical_data.historical_prior_exposure: JANUS 010C had already analyzed ALL original physical trial outcomes, so 010M split is NOT truly untouched/blinded to researcher

models.M0: Bernoulli local probability conditional on own setting only; Jeffreys Beta(.5,.5) smoothing
models.Mpost: Negative collider/postselection control; selection by OTHER wing positive outcome, excludes these cases from primary predictive and hypothesis statistics
models.Mjanus: Bernoulli local probability conditional on own and other wing setting, same Jeffreys smoothing; only statistical proxy for claimed physical late causation

frozen_010M_analysis.hypothesis_family: Four two-sided local by remote conditional differences (Alice a0/1, Bob b0/1)
frozen_010M_analysis.inference: Large-N pooled binomial z approximation with Holm multiple comparisons

results.meaning_of_model_comparison: Alice proxy improves descriptive logscore by only 1.6e-6 bits/event while Bob worsens by 7e-6; no robust cross-wing general predictive advantage established, and none of this is retrocausal evidence
results.synthetic_proof_control: Independent uniform A,C with B=A XOR C has P(A=1|C)=1/2 unconditionally but perfect dependence when conditioning B=0
results.mathematics_no_signalling_proof: Local CPTP map on B has no influence on reduced rho_A, by partial trace and trace preservation

limitations: Not independent newly collected data; 010C had previously inspected this ETH archive.
The ETH four-column Bell results are spatially separated choices/outcomes, not A physically committed before later free choice C.
No per-shot timestamp, externally signed early A record or independently calibrated timelike event ordering.
Trial independence and stationarity of asymptotic z tests are not independently guaranteed; fixed block heuristics do not cure all memory effects.
Big conditional associations are entanglement and collider/selection phenomena, not future-to-past signals.
No formal equivalence/effect-absence bound established by this experiment; failure to reject is not proof of universal no-signalling.
True JANUS prospective independent late choice protocol stays sealed and scientifically unsatisfied.
next_gate: Acquire truly unseen prospective data with independent physically late free setting C, externally timestamped early A and uncertainty accounting; independent blinded replication. Existing ETH archive only supports retrospective no-signalling diagnostic and collider error study.
